label: Every giving by a one-power HAS_INTELLECT_1 being is by a rational power
description: The intellect route to giving by a rational power (argument A). Under will following intellect, will having a rational power, giving exercising an owned power, and the same giver having one power, every giving exercises that rational power. This excludes the formally defined CHANCE_3 branch under the complete bundle (controls, law 13), without restating DNP_inv. Rational has the stated intellectual-inclination interpretation but is a unary classification in the Lean overlay; the theorem encodes no content-indexed relation of practical governance. It therefore does not establish that this giving is directed by apprehended D or that a particular recipient-good is willed. A cognitive-but-nonoperative challenge retaining Rational is not a CHANCE_3 countermodel to this theorem. The converse from Rational to intellect is not proved. Other warrants for will can discriminate at this classification level (law 6); the DNP_inv route still depends on its own warrant. Constructive, not a transcription; establishes no premise, GOD_4 identity or modal profile. The existing omission controls retain their exact formal scope. Actual-direction assessment: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md and docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md.
